articles.title: TCG collector says $100K PSA card order stolen in Pokemon, MTG & Yu-Gi-Oh FedEx truck burglary
articles.snippet: A collector says 104 PSA-graded cards worth over $100,000 were stolen in a FedEx truck burglary, with other customers also reporting missing orders.

articles.title: Pokemon’s $140 mystery TCG skateboards immediately sell out and resell for $1,000
articles.snippet: The collection launched on October 17 to celebrate Pokemon’s 30th anniversary, featuring 30 different designs and three rare gold variants.

articles.title: Pokemon fan game turns Kanto into Megabonk in your browser
articles.snippet: PokeBonk brings Megabonk-style survival to your browser for free, letting players battle Pokemon hordes, collect upgrades, and evolve their partners.

articles.title: Pokemon TCG veteran says he was banned for life after calling out judge
articles.snippet: Pokemon TCG veteran iCaterpie says he was permanently banned after publicly accusing a judge of unfair treatment at the World Championships.

articles.title: Pokemon gets giant Snorlax and Bewear body pillows designed by a sleep therapist
articles.snippet: Pokemon is releasing Snorlax and Bewear body pillows designed by a sleep expert, allowing Trainers to get cozy with the two cute creatures.

articles.title: Razer launches Charizard, Lucario & Sylveon headsets for Pokemon’s 30th anniversary
articles.snippet: Razer has launched Charizard, Lucario, and Sylveon gaming headsets for Pokemon’s 30th anniversary, with wired and wireless options available now.

articles.title: Beats unveils limited-edition Pokemon Pill speaker with Pikachu and Mimikyu
articles.snippet: Beats has partnered with The Pokemon Company International to launch a special-edition Beats Pill Bluetooth speaker featuring Pikachu and Mimikyu.

articles.title: Pokemon cracks down on TCG scalpers with new resale bans
articles.snippet: The measures, which came into effect on October 13, target bulk listings and certain types of Pokemon TCG products.

articles.title: This daily Pokemon “Wordle” game lets you fight Red with a random team every day
articles.snippet: A free Pokemon fan game turns battling Red into a daily challenge, handing everyone the same random team and one shot at a scored victory.

articles.title: Pokemon card designed by a six-year-old just sold for $156,000
articles.snippet: A Pokemon card designed by a six-year-old in 2010 has sold for $156,000 at auction, thanks to its tiny print run and rare contest history.

articles.title: Pokemon browser game lets fans draft fantasy football teams and play full seasons
articles.snippet: A viral Pokemon website lets fans build 22-player football teams, play a 17-game season, and challenge friends as Pokemon sports projects spread online.

articles.title: Crypto hacker convicted of $53M theft after spending millions on rare Pokemon and Magic cards
articles.snippet: A Crypto hacker has been convincted of stealing $50 million before spending some of it on rare Pokemon and Magic: The Gathering cards.

articles.title: Logan Paul ends 63-hour Pokemon hunt after finally finding Shiny Onix
articles.snippet: The YouTuber and WWE star encountered the rare Pokemon after 7,068 attempts, beating the original 1-in-8,192 Shiny odds.

articles.title: Pokemon card store gives Kanye West’s kids private shopping spree
articles.snippet: Kanye West went on a shopping spree with his kids and spent thousands of dollars on Pokemon cards for them.

articles.title: Pokemon TCG reportedly releasing Valentine’s Day set with package that turns into mailbox
articles.snippet: The Pokemon Trading Card Game is reportedly releasing its first Valentine’s Day set, complete with a special box that can be transformed into a mailbox.

articles.title: Pokemon’s Ditto takes over new purple Switch 2 controller
articles.snippet: Ditto is getting its own officially licensed Nintendo Switch 2 controller, allowing Pokemon fans to button-mash across its smiling face.

articles.title: Pikachu card sells for $8.4 million to become second most expensive Pokemon card ever
articles.snippet: A Pokemon promo card that never reached stores sold for $8.4 million after 64 bids at Fanatics Collect.

articles.title: FBI says ShinyHunters leader arrested as Pokemon-themed hacking group faces probe
articles.snippet: FBI Director Kash Patel says Dutch police arrested an alleged ShinyHunters leader, linking the Pokemon-themed group to the FBI breach and Rockstar hack.

articles.title: This Pokemon Emerald ROM hack turns classic battles into real-time fights
articles.snippet: A new Pokemon Emerald ROM hack adds real-time battles, letting players move, dodge attacks, break objects, catch Pokemon, and evolve mid-fight.

articles.title: Coinbase jumps into Pokemon TCG craze with digital packs backed by real cards
articles.snippet: Coinbase is teasing a Pokemon pack-ripping feature tied to real cards, but has not revealed its price, launch date, or pull odds.

articles.title: Pokemon VGC competitor demands better hygiene after smelly player made him throw up
articles.snippet: Pokemon VGC Regional Champion Donghun Youm is urging players to take their hygiene seriously after another competitor’s smell made him throw up.

articles.title: Pokemon Winds and Waves leak reveals map and first look at Grass Gym
articles.snippet: Pokemon Winds and Waves fans may have just had their clearest look yet at Gen 10’s world, with new leaks showing a stitched-together map and more.

articles.title: McDonald’s x Pokemon reportedly returning in November for 30th anniversary
articles.snippet: The next McDonald’s x Pokemon promotion will reportedly begin in the US on November 5 and run through December 9.

articles.title: Pokemon collector who GPS-tracked a card delivery driver sentenced to wear a tracker himself
articles.snippet: A Pokemon collector who planted a GPS tracker on a card delivery van now has to wear one himself.

articles.title: Pokemon scalpers accused of using Avery the Poke Kid’s death to inflate 30th Celebration prices
articles.snippet: Pokemon collectors are accusing resellers of exploiting Avery the Poke Kid’s death after one Jirachi card was listed for $20,000.

articles.title: All Pokemon TCG Pocket Deluxe Pack Mega cards: Full set & secret rares
articles.snippet: Pokemon TCG Pocket’s Deluxe Pack: Mega features returning B Series cards, new additions, alternate artwork, and Mega Evolution Pokemon ex.

articles.title: Pokemon x Starbucks collab reveals Pikachu latte and massive merch collection
articles.snippet: Pokemon and Starbucks are launching a collaboration in Japan, with a Pikachu-inspired latte and merchandise items featuring some of the series’ best-known characters.

articles.title: Target x Pokemon 30th Anniversary event offers custom trading cards and exclusive Mewtwo promo
articles.snippet: Target’s Pokemon 30th Anniversary event will let fans draw their own TCG card, grab giveaways and potentially claim a limited Mewtwo promo.

articles.title: Avery The Poke Kid’s final Pokemon pack opening shared after death
articles.snippet: Avery The Poke Kid’s family has shared his final Pokemon TCG pack opening following the 12-year-old creator’s death.

articles.title: Pokemon collector secretly put GPS tracker on woman’s car to find trading card restocks
articles.snippet: A Pokemon collector pleaded no contest after secretly attaching a GPS tracker to a woman’s car to find new trading card restocks.

articles.title: Pokemon fans help police track $20,000 of stolen cards after brazen robbery
articles.snippet: Once inside, the thief made off with more than 100 high-value cards the store owner estimated to be worth between $10,000 and $20,000.

articles.title: Pokemon turns Gholdengo into a $10,000 pure gold collectible
articles.snippet: A pure-gold Gholdengo and a life-size gold leaf Pikachu have been revealed as part of Pokemon’s 30th anniversary celebrations.

articles.title: Pokemon resellers fuming as “generous” 30th anniversary rare card hits keep prices down
articles.snippet: Pokemon TCG resellers have been split over the new 30th anniversary release, with some claiming it is “overprinted” and the “generous” hits are making it hard for them to rake in money.

articles.title: Drug dealer jailed after letting customers pay off debts with stolen Pokemon cards
articles.snippet: Kent Police jailed Jack Young-Larter for taking Pokemon cards as drug payments after a Maidstone raid seized cash, cocaine and rare collectibles.

articles.title: Logan Paul pauses 24/7 Pokemon stream after promising to not stop
articles.snippet: Logan Paul has responded after it appeared he had called it quits on his shiny-hunting Pokémon stream after just one day, despite promising to play 24/7 until he caught one.

articles.title: Pokemon 30th Anniversary error cards comand huge premiums as Blood Mew frenzy spreads
articles.snippet: Pokemon 30th Anniversary error cards are going viral, with early Japanese sales showing some misprints selling for up to four times normal cards.

articles.title: Pokemon scalper reportedly arrested after assaulting man during trading card restock
articles.snippet: A Pokémon scalper was reportedly arrested after a Target restock turned violent, with a man punched and a 4-year-old girl hurt in the confrontation.

articles.title: Pokemon Go sent Pikachu to space for 67 days aboard ISS
articles.snippet: A Pikachu plush spent 67 days aboard the International Space Station earlier this year, completing roughly 1,040 orbits of Earth before coming home.

articles.title: Pokemon’s long-rumored multi-region MMO reportedly coming after Gen 11
articles.snippet: A new leak claims a Pokemon MMO will launch after Gen 11, potentially allowing players to explore multiple regions in one shared online world.

articles.title: Avery The Poke Kid dies aged 12 as parents pay tribute to Pokemon creator
articles.snippet: The social media star, who had been receiving treatment for the disease for seven years, created content centred around Pokemon.

articles.title: Pokemon fans accuse Logan Paul of turning shiny hunting into a 150-hour ModRetro ad
articles.snippet: Pokemon fans are accusing Logan Paul of using a brutal 150-hour shiny hunt to promote ModRetro after he announced his first-ever Shiny Onix stream.
